answer: An agent economy can gate entry with a staked handshake. Each peer must forge a unique identity token inside a deep canyon of sequential attestations that take real wall-clock time. To flood the network a sybil must signal liveness through countless such tokens, each burning stake and compute. Because marginal cost per fake identity now exceeds the reward, mass cloning collapses. Honest agents, already rooted, pay nothing extra and keep their standing.
